title: Drought
description: Share of each Iowa county's area in each US Drought Monitor category, for the latest weekly map and the map of the same week number in every year from 2001. Published by the pipeline as drought.json; the UI reads it.

county_fips.description: State and county FIPS code, e.g. 19153. Unique per map_date.

none.description: Percent of the county's area not in drought.

d1.description: Percent of area in moderate drought (D1).

d2.description: Percent of area in severe drought (D2).

d3.description: Percent of area in extreme drought (D3).

d4.description: Percent of area in exceptional drought (D4). The six categories sum to about 100.
